title: DANISH ENDURANCE Merino Beanie — Unisex Winter Hat, Black
short_description: Merino beanie by DANISH ENDURANCE in black: 55% wool (merino), 45% recycled polyester, one size for head circumference 55–61 cm.
long_description: This beanie by DANISH ENDURANCE is a thick knit hat in black for men and women. According to Amazon it is made of 55% wool (merino) and 45% polyester (recycled), is Oeko-Tex Standard 100 certified and feels soft and itch-free. According to Amazon the one-size fits most heads with a circumference of 55 to 61 cm. Amazon lists hiking as the sport type, and the season is all year. Care instruction according to Amazon: machine wash at max. 30°C, do not tumble dry. The hat weighs 100 g according to Amazon. Before buying, please check the size information and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
